scripts.native:sync: npm run build && npm --prefix native run sync
scripts.native:sync:ios: npm run build && npm --prefix native run sync:ios
scripts.native:sync:android: npm run build && npm --prefix native run sync:android
scripts.native:assets:android: node tools/appicon.mjs --android && node tools/splash.mjs --android && npm --prefix native run assets:android
scripts.native:verify: npm run native:sync && node --experimental-strip-types tests/iosship.test.ts --require-synced && node --experimental-strip-types tests/androidship.test.ts --require-synced
scripts.native:bundle:android: npm run native:sync:android && npm --prefix native run bundle:android
scripts.appstore:screenshots:generate: npm run build && npm run appstore:screenshots:capture && npm run appstore:screenshots:finalize && npm run appstore:screenshots:verify
scripts.appstore:screenshots:check: FASTLANE_OPT_OUT_USAGE=1 FASTLANE_SKIP_UPDATE_CHECK=1 BUNDLE_PATH=vendor/bundle /opt/homebrew/opt/ruby/bin/bundle exec fastlane ios screenshots_check
scripts.appstore:screenshots:plan: FASTLANE_OPT_OUT_USAGE=1 FASTLANE_SKIP_UPDATE_CHECK=1 BUNDLE_PATH=vendor/bundle /opt/homebrew/opt/ruby/bin/bundle exec fastlane ios screenshots_plan --env appstore
scripts.appstore:screenshots:upload: FASTLANE_OPT_OUT_USAGE=1 FASTLANE_SKIP_UPDATE_CHECK=1 BUNDLE_PATH=vendor/bundle /opt/homebrew/opt/ruby/bin/bundle exec fastlane ios screenshots_upload --env appstore
